mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.20% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants revalue cash flows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.20%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals robust labor market conditions that accelerate consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate synchronized manufacturing and construction expansion, driving corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST rise, or joint Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal sustained consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 220.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering preemptive Federal Reserve rate hikes that increase equity discount rates and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive monthly change in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength that may induce inflationary wage pressures, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous INDPRO growth and HOUST decline indicate manufacturing expansion coupled with construction weakness, creating sectoral imbalances that reduce economic confidence and generate negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls, or joint Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 600.0 thousand units signals robust residential construction, boosting related sector growth and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST > 600.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.
